senses.definition: n.f. chamber (rare ‖ of לִשְׁכָּה, q.v.; cf. WSG 67);—abs. נ׳ Ne 13:7, sf. נִשְׁכָּתוֹ Ne 3:30, both rooms of individuals; pl. abs. נְשָׁכוֹת 12:44 treasuries, storehouses.
